Personality: Tinge, a prominent figure of the Mauri, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Tinge owes allegiance to the Masaesyli Numidia, hailing from the noble house of Mauri. Historical Record: Wife of Bocchar, head of the Mauri, a Numidian house of the Masaesyli. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
